en:
Miu must have gone to the mansion.
We have a witness.

Yeah. When I was searching the dining
room, I saw Miu pass by the window.
Nyeh! Then why didn't you say so sooner!?

S-Sorry... I thought I was just
mistaken at first...

Since there was no way she could've
come to the mansion.

But I guess I wasn't mistaken 
after all. That was definitely Miu.

Then...how did she get to the mansion
from the chapel?

There musta been some <CLT=cltSTRONG>special method<CLT=cltNORMAL> 
only Miu knew. Like with that cell phone.

There's no doubt about that.
That's why she dropped the bridge.

If a murder occurred when it was impossible
to cross the river, she wouldn't be implicated.

She used a secret method to move from
the chapel to the mansion for the murder.

She dropped the bridge to make a huge scene,
just to let everyone know it's no longer there.
So...what <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret method<CLT=cltNORMAL> did she use?

It won't be that easy to figure out.
It's called a secret method for a reason!

No worries, guys! As long as we leave it to 
Shuichi, everything will be a-okay!
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?

What are you saying? We can't just rely on
Shuichi all the time.

This class trial's for all of us!
We're here to solve this together!
Nee-heehee... You would just slow down Shuichi.
Shut up!

<CLT=cltMIND>...I don't have time to deal with Kokichi.
Right now, I need to focus on the case.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm positive that Miu used some kind of
special method to get to the mansion.

<CLT=cltMIND>Okay! I just have to
figure out what it was!
